text.content: Nordvik Freight coordinates wholesale shipments across Norway, Sweden, and Finland. Their operations team handles hundreds of supplier queries each week. This includes questions about pricing windows, route availability, and customs compliance documentation. Until now, those queries have been handled manually by three specialist teams. Nordvik's product lead, Astrid, has been tasked with building the company's first internal multi-agent system to route and respond to those queries automatically.
